title: English Practice Quiz 0194
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: The team finished the work contains a subject and a complete predicate.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: She is good at ___.
questions.explanation: A preposition such as at is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: She ___ the report before the manager arrived.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural of 'child'.
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.question: A professional way to ask for a file is:
options: Could you please share the file?
questions.explanation: Could you please is a polite and professional request.

questions.question: Please ___ the correct answer.
questions.explanation: Choose is the base verb used after please.

questions.question: They said, 'We have finished.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect commonly shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

questions.question: They ___ ready for the meeting.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural subject they.
